    What is stored

    The model reference, quantity, selected configuration, customization choices and any product note are stored in this browser only — no prices, images or personal details. They stay on this device until you clear the list or send it as an enquiry.

    Adding twice

    Adding a product that is already on the list increases its quantity instead of creating a second row. Quantities can be edited here before you send the list.

    Sending the list

    Request a Quote carries every row over with its quantity, configuration, customization choices and notes. Copy or download the list if you would rather attach it to an email yourself.
